title: Dread Tide - Raft survival mixed with Bloons Tower Defense. Looking for feedback
author: Vivid_Escalation
selftext:
Hey all,

This is my game Dread Tide I've been working on for a few months now. Looking for play testers to give any and all feedback.

The quick pitch is it's like Raft mixed with Bloons tower defense. You are sailing to visit different checkpoints on the map. Each checkpoint has waves of enemies to fend off at night. During the day, you collect supplies from the water around the raft using your hook. You will use the supplies to build up your raft and defenses. You do this in preparation for the monsters that come at night.

Sometimes you will get checkpoints that give you a merchant visit or free heals as a break from the fighting. The merchant allows you to purchase new weapons and upgrades. Every time you level up you get to choose from a stat boost, every 3 level gives a relic to boost more unique stats.

I think I want to change this around and make it so you can earn/find weapons instead of buying from merchants but thats something to work out still.

I recently added a concept of Salvage, which is meant to carry over between runs to give you permanent upgrades to your ship to make consecutive runs easier.

I've had this game in mind for awhile and started coding it with Claude a few months ago. I've sunk probably close to 2 months time developing this out. It's gotten to a point where I am pretty burnt out testing it myself and its burning me out from wanting to do more Dev so posting in hopes to get some feedback and direction outside of just my thoughts.
